articles.summary: JACKSONVILLE, Fla., March 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fidelity National Financial, Inc. (NYSE: FNF) (FNF) today announced that Jeffrey Heighton has joined FNF Agency Operations as President of Enterprise Solutions – Agency. In this role, Jeff will partner with title agents across the FNF Agency
articles.title: Jeffrey Heighton Joins Fidelity National Financial's Agency Operations as President of Enterprise Solutions
